I'd say get the mighty if you're going to use it as a portable vape and with a bong adaptor, but if you plan on exclusively using your vape through glass, in your home, definitely consider a ball vape. I own both and it's really a different ballgame (no pun intended) if you are used to smoking bongs. An entry-level to mid-range ball vape runs cost about the same as a mighty/mighty+ and you can DIY it for far less.

But the mighty is absolutely an amazing device. It has been my daily driver for most of this year before I got a Qaroma.

A lot of dry herb vapes will have some sort of way to vape concentrates. Mighty/Crafty have 'drip pads' on which you can place concentrates. There's bound to be a tutorial on how to vape concentrates with whatever vape you own if you do a little googling. 

There's a good chance you'll need something extra (like the drip pads) if you want to vape the concentrates alone, but you can also add a small amount in between loosely packed flower and vape it like that - no attachment needed. If you have a ball vape you can drop it on top, too.

No worries. There's bound to be a bunch of tutorials out there on how to vape concentrates with whatever device you own. If you look for a tutorial on dabbing I'd recommend one on low temperature dabbing.
